title: gumira divaricata
intro: Gumira divaricata, commonly known as the "Indian toothbrush," is a medicinal plant that belongs to the family Rubiaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to protect against infections, reduce inflammation, and promote overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Gumira divaricata include its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve diarrhea, and treat skin conditions, making it a popular choice in traditional medicine. Bioactive constituents of Gumira divaricata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable resource for natural remedies.
